link.0c2ff29f5390.source: Codex CLI uses AGENTS.md instructions. Sandbox settings limit access; approval policy controls review. Workspace edits and commands can run automatically within those limits.
link.0c2ff29f5390.value: Codex CLI 使用 AGENTS.md 指令。沙箱设置限制访问范围；批准策略控制审查。工作区内的编辑和命令可在这些限制内自动执行。

link.3169d9d32831.source: Connect your launchable on Module 3a first. Type a command, click a chip, or press Tab to autocomplete. On the host, openshell sandbox list shows your agent and openshell status reports the gateway. Your agent runs inside a sandbox, so prefix a command with agent to run it there: agent ls lists its files through openshell sandbox exec. Each command runs in its own short-lived shell, so to chat with the agent interactively, use the panel below rather than the openclaw tui.
link.3169d9d32831.value: 请先在模块 3a 中连接 launchable。输入命令、点击快捷项，或按 Tab 键自动补全。在宿主上，openshell sandbox list 会显示智能体，openshell status 会报告网关状态。智能体在沙箱内运行，因此可在命令前加上agent，让命令在其中运行：agent ls 会通过 openshell sandbox exec 列出智能体的文件。每条命令都在各自的短生命周期 shell 中运行，因此如需与智能体进行交互式对话，请使用下方面板，而不是 openclaw tui。

link.3fb438ebe474.source: Hermes provides skills, persistent memory, scheduled jobs, and configured messaging integrations. Its approval mode and terminal backend determine command handling and isolation.
link.3fb438ebe474.value: Hermes 提供技能、持久记忆、计划任务及经过配置的消息集成。批准模式与终端后端决定命令的处理和隔离方式。

link.4e7f5eaf2c72.source: Cursor uses .cursor/rules/*.mdc. Workspace edits generally run without approval; terminal commands require approval by default. Modes and settings can change those checks.
link.4e7f5eaf2c72.value: Cursor 使用 .cursor/rules/*.mdc。工作区编辑通常无需批准；终端命令默认需要批准。模式和设置可能改变这些检查。

link.8a61ef7d5dcd.source: Claude Code uses CLAUDE.md instructions. Tool rules, permission mode, and sandbox settings determine which actions run or require approval.
link.8a61ef7d5dcd.value: Claude Code 使用 CLAUDE.md 指令。工具规则、权限模式和沙箱设置决定哪些操作可执行或需要批准。

link.b047682ccf8f.source: OpenClaw uses workspace files such as SOUL.md and AGENTS.md, gateway sessions, and scheduled triggers. In this course it runs inside OpenShell. Inspect the active policy and gateway permissions to assess its reach.
link.b047682ccf8f.value: OpenClaw 使用 SOUL.md、AGENTS.md 等工作区文件、网关会话与定时触发器。本课程中，它在 OpenShell 内运行。请检查当前生效的策略和网关权限以评估其可及范围。

link.c6404472b58c.source:
The terminal above is the operator plane. The host shell manages the sandboxed agent. Commands sent with agent <cmd> run inside that agent environment; host commands use operator permissions. Inspect both boundaries as in Module 4a.

  • Setup. This runtime is already provisioned. A separate CLI needs its own installation and configuration.
  • Reach. File, network, and process permissions depend on the environment. Inspect the actual grants.
  • Blast radius. Prompt injection may cause harm through allowed capabilities. Compare available actions, enforcement, and audit evidence.
link.c6404472b58c.value:
上方终端属于操作员平面。主机 Shell 管理沙箱中的智能体。通过 agent <cmd> 发送的命令在该智能体环境内执行；主机命令则使用操作员权限。请按照模块 4a 检查这两个边界。

  • 设置。此运行时已配置。独立的 CLI 需要另外安装和配置。
  • 可及范围。文件、网络和进程权限取决于环境。请检查实际授予的权限。
  • 影响范围。提示注入可能通过获准的能力造成伤害。请比较可用的操作、限制的执行情况及审计证据。

link.f315fc4fd0d3.source: The openclaw tui is an interactive, full-screen chat that a one-shot terminal cannot hold open. The panel below talks to the same live agent over the OpenClaw gateway, the /cli/gateway connection Modules 3b and 3c use, so you can chat with it without leaving the page. It streams the agent's reply and shows each tool or command the agent runs. Connect your launchable on Module 3a first (its URL and token). Ask it anything, click a prompt, or press Tab to autocomplete.
link.f315fc4fd0d3.value: openclaw tui 是一种交互式全屏对话界面，单次运行的终端无法让它持续保持打开。下方面板通过 OpenClaw 网关与同一个实时智能体通信，使用的是 /cli/gateway 连接，模块 3b 和模块 3c 也使用这条连接，因此您无需离开当前页面即可与智能体对话。面板会流式显示智能体的回复，并展示智能体运行的每项工具或命令。请先在模块 3a 中连接 launchable（及其 URL 和 token）。可以提出任何问题、点击提示词，或按 Tab 键自动补全。

text.fea5e26452e1.source: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on the operator's devices and communicates through configured channels. The NemoClaw reference stack used by this course runs OpenClaw inside OpenShell so filesystem, process, network, and inference access can be governed outside the model.
text.fea5e26452e1.value: OpenClaw 是一种个人 AI 助手，在 operator 的设备上运行，并通过已配置的渠道通信。本课程使用的 NemoClaw 参考技术栈在 OpenShell 内运行 OpenClaw，因此可以在模型外部管控文件系统、进程、网络和推理访问。
